name: Infomina Berhad
summary: Infomina Berhad, an investment holding company, provides technology application and infrastructure solutions in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Japan. It operates through two segments: Technology Infrastructure Operations, Maintenance, and Support Services; and Design and Delivery of Technology Infrastructure Solutions. The company offers infrastructure and environment management solutions, such as intelligent data center and hybrid infrastructure; security, compliance, and resilience management; application and platform management services; and managed infrastructure services.
